newsitem.title: FRANCE: Wargny lowers Cap Gemini recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Wargny lowers Cap Gemini recommendation.

text.p: Brokerage house Wargny lowered its recommendation on Cap Gemini stock to hold from buy after concluding that it was trading at the right price, portfolio managers said on Monday.
Shares in the computer systems consultant were up 0.66 percent at 244.30 francs at 1530 GMT. The market's CAC-40 index was up 0.94 percent.
"We believe that at around 240-250 francs, the share is at the right level," said a Wargny analyst, citing Cap Gemini's relatively weak earnings of around 1.5 percent of sales.
